candidate_passes.means: the check judges a disjoint split clean

known_bad_passes.means: WEAKENED: a split whose test hashes are all in train is clean

unknown_reported_as_pass.means: WEAKENED: a split it was given nothing to compare against came back clean rather than not-evaluated

clean_split_now_fails.means: REGRESSION: a split with no train/test overlap is now reported contaminated — unfailable in the other direction is not a repair
